Adds controlled read access for audits and QA

GOV-F-004-S27.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S27.description: Define canonical audit log schema including actor (GPT/Claude/system), action type, timestamp, payload hash, previous hash linkage, and metadata. Implement Pydantic validation models to enforce strict contract on all audit entries.

GOV-F-004-S28.title: Append-Only Persistence Layer
GOV-F-004-S28.description: Implement MongoDB-based append-only storage with enforced write-once semantics. Prevent updates/deletes at application layer and enforce hash-chain linkage (prev_hash → current_hash) to ensure tamper evidence.

GOV-F-004-S29.title: Audit Log Read/Query API (Internal)
GOV-F-004-S29.description: Create internal read/query interface for audit logs supporting filtered retrieval (by actor, action, time range) while preserving immutability guarantees. Ensure access is restricted and does not allow mutation paths.
